facts.fact: Kai Rhodes 38 岁，Rhodes Creative Group（品牌与出版公司）创始人，办公室占市中心塔楼顶层
facts.anchor: At thirty-eight, he was the founder of Rhodes Creative Group, a powerful branding and publishing firm that occupied the top floors of a downtown tower.

facts.fact: 他的世界三定律：噪音=无能、混乱=计划失败、情绪=浪费计费时间
facts.anchor: In his world, noise was a sign of incompetence, chaos was a failure of planning, and emotions were a waste of billable hours.

facts.fact: 他 softly 毙掉季度提案：safe 等于 invisible，重设计视觉语言，限期下午四点
facts.anchor: And safe is another word for invisible. If I wanted invisible, I would have hired a ghost.

facts.fact: 助理 Marcus 告知 10:30 地区出版董事会推到 11:30、空出一小时；他拒绝要车，只说 Just coffee
facts.anchor: Mr. Rhodes, your 10:30 meeting with the regional publishing board was pushed to 11:30. You have an hour open.

facts.fact: 他步行两个街区走进银行与干洗店之间的 Tim Hortons，门口即被蒸汽棒/微波炉/闲聊三种噪音冲击
facts.anchor: It was tucked between a bank and a dry cleaner, looking entirely too modest for the neighborhood.

facts.fact: 角落狂野乱发女人爆发式打字并低念 Blood for the blood god；他二十年商务会议从未听过有人喝咖啡前低喊战号
facts.anchor: He had never heard anyone whisper a battle cry before drinking coffee.

facts.fact: 六岁男孩 Toby 撞上他后吓得嘴唇发抖道歉；他认得这表情（员工都挂着），放软声音答 It's fine
facts.anchor: Kai knew that expression—everyone who worked for him wore it. He softened his voice.

facts.fact: 她买第二杯咖啡时低语「咖啡因能否合法复活死人」，Kai 捕捉到——镇定出现一拍短暂失守
facts.anchor: Time to find out if caffeine can legally resurrect the dead
